title: WireGuard tunnel configurations
whyItMatters: WireGuard tunnel files hold private keys and peer endpoints. They reveal the networks this machine was set up to reach.
source: WireGuard official docs: manager service stores tunnels in %ProgramFiles%/WireGuard/Data/Configurations - https://github.com/WireGuard/wireguard-windows/blob/master/docs/enterprise.md
notes: No root token exists for Program Files, so SYSTEMDRIVE is used. Needs elevation: .conf.dpapi files are readable only by Local System and administrators. Unconfirmed: non-default install paths are not matched.
